label: State and local tax deduction
jct_line_label: Deduction of nonbusiness State and local government taxes
definition_note: Individual income tax revenue loss FY2025 for the itemized deduction of nonbusiness State and local government taxes.

label: Medical expense deduction
jct_line_label: Deduction for medical expenses and long-term care expenses
definition_note: Individual income tax revenue loss FY2025; the JCT line covers medical expenses and long-term care expenses.

label: Charitable contribution deduction, other than education and health
jct_line_label: Deduction for charitable contributions, other than for education and health
definition_note: Individual income tax revenue loss FY2025; the corporate column is not read. JCT footnote 12: the estimate also accounts for the higher percentage limitation for public charities and for other special rules of the charitable deduction.

label: Charitable contribution deduction, education
jct_line_label: Deduction for charitable contributions to educational institutions
definition_note: Individual income tax revenue loss FY2025; the corporate column is not read.

label: Charitable contribution deduction, health
jct_line_label: Deduction for charitable contributions to health organizations
definition_note: Individual income tax revenue loss FY2025; the corporate column is not read.

label: Deductible mortgage interest
jct_line_label: Deduction for mortgage interest on owner-occupied residences
definition_note: Individual income tax revenue loss FY2025 for deductible mortgage interest on owner-occupied residences.

label: Qualified business income deduction
definition_note: Individual income tax revenue loss FY2025 for the qualified business income deduction.

label: Self-employed health insurance deduction
jct_line_label: Deduction for health insurance premiums and long-term care insurance premiums by the self-employed
definition_note: Individual income tax revenue loss FY2025; JCT line includes long-term care insurance premiums deducted by the self-employed.

label: Health savings account deduction
definition_note: Individual income tax revenue loss FY2025; JCT footnote 14: includes employer contributions made through cafeteria plans, which also appear in other line items.

label: Student loan interest deduction
jct_line_label: Deduction for interest on student loans
definition_note: Individual income tax revenue loss FY2025.

label: Self-employed pension (Keogh) net exclusion
jct_line_label: Net exclusion of pension contributions and earnings: Plans covering partners and sole proprietors (sometimes referred to as "Keogh plans")
definition_note: Individual income tax revenue loss FY2025; JCT measures the NET EXCLUSION of contributions and earnings (inside buildup), broader than the above-the-line contribution deduction alone - broad-fit anchor only.

label: Traditional IRA net exclusion
definition_note: Individual income tax revenue loss FY2025; JCT measures the net exclusion of contributions and earnings, broader than the contribution deduction alone - broad-fit anchor only.

label: CDCC and employer child care exclusion
jct_line_label: Credit for child and dependent care and exclusion of employer-provided child care
definition_note: Individual income tax revenue loss FY2025; COMBINED line: the credit plus the employer-provided child care exclusion (JCT footnote 11 includes dependent care FSA purchases; footnote 3: the estimate includes the credit's refundability, an outlay effect of 0.7 billion dollars in FY2025); not a clean CDCC-only concept.
